note: Rewritten from Sands' (1999) new species description, original in English; the genus lacks soldiers, only the worker has a complete description; measurements follow the original ranges.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: This species is distinguished by the crest formed by the large conical spines on the enteric valve ridges. From A. camerunensis it differs in having a smaller third distal spur of the fore tibia, the anterior margin of the third marginal tooth of the left mandible as long as that of the first, fewer apical spines in the primary rows, and far less developed secondary rows. From A. congoensis it differs in being larger, with longer fore legs, the fourth marginal tooth of the left mandible just touching the lateral edge of the molar prominence, and large, straight, conical spines on the primary-row ridges, the valve nearly six-radiate. From A. dibogi it differs as given under that species: the latter has a long and inflated first hindgut segment, the enteric valve seat displaced dorsally, fine long primary-row spines and densely spinose secondary-row scales.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, the darkest part of the antennal flagellum pale yellow or yellow, pronotum and legs yellowish white, abdominal tergites transparent. Head capsule short-oval, nearly circular or oval, setae sparse, projecting, the longest setae arranged regularly and symmetrically. Fontanelle present as a pale spot or shallow depression, or absent. Anterior surface of the fore coxa with 4 or more stout setae arranged in rows or groups; fore tibia with 3 distal spurs, the third reduced or far smaller than the other two. Left mandible: first marginal tooth nearly equilateral, anterior margin of the third marginal tooth as long as that of the first marginal tooth, the fourth marginal tooth just touching the lateral edge of the molar prominence in frontal view; right mandible: anterior margin of the first marginal tooth shorter than that of the second marginal tooth. Measurements: head width 0.673—0.717 mm; pronotum width 0.448—0.512 mm, length 0.221—0.265 mm; hind tibia length 0.727—0.765 mm; fore tibia length 0.575—0.608 mm; left mandible index 0.871—0.965, right mandible index 0.968—1.265.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The midgut–hindgut junction arises ventrally below the nerve cord; the first hindgut segment is rather short, up to 8 times as long as its proximal width, tubular throughout; in the undissected abdomen the enteric valve lies to the right of the heart (dorsal view) or to the left of the nerve cord (ventral view); the third lobe of the enteric valve seat is nearly as large as the outer pair. The enteric valve ridges are nearly taper-ellipsoid from the base towards the apical spines, the ends sclerotized, pale brown or yellowish brown; the primary rows of all ridges consist of large, upright conical spines directed backwards, ridges one, three and four with at most 14, ridge two with fewer than 10, straight and evenly tapering, not wider than the narrowest point of ridge three; the secondary rows bear conspicuous spines on one or more ridges, lengthening towards the ridge apex, the outlines of the scales or reticulation blurred; the membrane between and outside the ridges bears minute spines, with marginal scales proximally.
